teaching.1mL.setTeachingChannel.description: Sets the 1 mL channel used for teaching. Not allowed while a teaching needle is held.

teaching.1mL.getTeachingChannel.description: Returns the 1 mL channel used for teaching.

teaching.1mL.pickupTeachingNeedle.description: Picks up a teaching needle with the teaching channel and measures its length.

teaching.1mL.ejectTeachingNeedle.description: Returns the teaching needle to its pickup position.

teaching.1mL.isNeedlePickedUp.description: Returns whether the teaching channel is holding a teaching needle.

teaching.1mL.getLabwareDimensions.description: Returns a labware's center, bottom and height, and a well's center, bottom and depth.

teaching.1mL.moveChannelToPosition.description: Moves the teaching channel to an X/Y/Z position (needle tip coordinates) over a traverse height.

teaching.1mL.measureZHeight.description: Searches down with the teaching needle until a Z stall and returns the stall height.

teaching.1mL.measureXY.description: Steps along one axis probing Z with the teaching needle until a wall is found and returns its coordinate.
